entries.1adeff3286fbf9b5: An automotive parts manufacturer whose main products are clutches for motorcycles and automobiles, producing at sites around the world and supplying them to vehicle manufacturers.
entries.45b036c581cdf659: This business manufactures and sells clutches for manual and automatic cars, as well as products in the EV/CASE field. Subsidiaries across the world, including in the United States, Mexico, Thailand, China, India, Vietnam and Brazil, are responsible for production. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥135,975 million, the largest of the 3 segments.
entries.52ebe91ec00a670d: This business mainly manufactures and sells products and provides services in fields such as environment and energy.
entries.5409e4ce1a15f2f6: This business manufactures and sells clutches for motorcycles, scooters, ATVs (buggies) and other vehicles, as well as products in the EV/CASE field. In some regions, sales are handled by sales subsidiaries in Indonesia. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥124,691 million.
